title: oven-fried korean teque os fried-rice
description: A spicy and savory twist on traditional fried rice, featuring crispy teque os and a rich mother sauce.

ingredients.name: teque os
ingredients.notes: pre-fried and broken into small pieces

instructions: In a large bowl, toss teque os with 1 tablespoon coconut oil until evenly coated.
Spread teque os on a baking sheet and bake for 10 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon coconut oil over medium-high heat.
Add garlic and ginger and stir-fry for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add mother sauce base, gochujang, and soy sauce, and stir-fry for an additional 2 minutes.
Add cooked brown rice to the skillet and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, until heated through.
Add crispy teque os to the skillet and stir-fry for an additional 2 minutes.
Transfer rice mixture to a serving platter and garnish with chopped scallions.
